scope: Additive read-only Figure4 A3 coordinate correction; original accepted E0 and normalized-stage bytes remain immutable; final decision v3 unchanged
authority: Figure4 brief A3: Site position = heading angle times actual C/(2pi); peak maximum sensitivity. Root approved literal material-origin overlay on20October before derived literal-coordinate outcomes.

primary.heading: Physical native M1 phase, not normalized/rotated P phase
primary.branch: At the beginning of every valid contiguous section choose phase in[0,2pi), then use shortest increments within that section only
primary.qualification: abs(P)>=0.1 AND exactly one native raw half-contrast component AND native scalar contrast>=0.1 times exact native basal contrast
primary.dilation: Actual-C changes contribute to this coordinate; no dilation subtraction

peak_sensitivity.heading: 2pi times native material position q of the first native profile maximum
peak_sensitivity.coordinate: Same fixed-origin literal map, actual native profile circumference, own profile contrast, exact corresponding scalar R and region count
peak_sensitivity.ties: Native first-index argmax; no subgrid interpolation
peak_sensitivity.cadence: Retain actual profile cadence and all supported lag values; do not imply scalar-rate observation

retained_sensitivities.heading_arc: Integrate shortest heading increments using midpoint actual circumference, excludes origin-dependent dilation term
retained_sensitivities.heading_direct: Track-reanchored heading difference times actual C(t)/(2pi)

uncertainty: 2000 whole-seed bootstrap draws, same frozen per-condition/pairing seed key as accepted stage; never frames as replicates
windows: All seven frozen A7 views, own contiguous-valid coverage at every lag
independent_audit: Separately implemented physical-phase/peak extraction, masks and literal coordinates at every retained native sample; exact every-lag pair coverage; direct differences and whole-seed intervals at all2-10cadence and predetermined interior/last audit lags
Dx: Dtheta times squared mean actual circumference/(2pi) remains a separate conversion, not a slope fit to literal coordinate MSD
no_changes: H1/H2/H3 criteria or active final-statistics v3 closure

reason: Independent direct-native audit identified actual exactly antipodal sampled peak jumps; their winding route is unresolved. Literal x centering and FFT tolerances remain unchanged.

antipodal.tie_definition: Adjacent qualified phases have a shortest difference within1e-12 radians of either+pi or-pi
antipodal.frame_retention: Both native frames stay qualified and retained; a new track label begins after the ambiguous edge. Only lag pairs spanning that edge are excluded from primary MSD.
antipodal.coverage: Report before-split eligible pairs and coverage, unambiguous pairs, all lost-pair counts/fractions, plus actual tie counts and seeds with ties at every method/view.
antipodal.uncertainty: The two deterministic route choices share the exact same seed bootstrap weights. They are not independent seeds or an exhaustive uncertainty bound.
antipodal.full_heading: Count actual antipodal steps for native-M1 heading at full cadence and every downsampled view; do not assume no effect before checking.

accepted_v1_outputs: None: all attempted literal-v1 arrays, failed audit receipts and held/cancelled exports remain preserved; all original E0/stage outputs remain immutable
